questions.question: By interchanging the given two numbers which of the following equation will be correct? 7 and 4
questions.questionHtml:
By interchanging the given two numbers which of the following equation will be correct?

7 and 4
questions.solution:
The pattern followed here is:

Let's check each option one by one:

Given: 7 and 4

Option 1) 4 - 7 + 6 ÷ 2 × 3 = 12

After interchanging the number we get the;

⇒ 7 - 4 + 6 ÷ 2 × 3 = 12

⇒ 7 - 4 + 3 × 3 = 12

⇒ 7 - 4 + 9 = 12

⇒ 16 - 4 = 12

⇒ 12 = 12

⇒ LHS = RHS

Option 2) 4 × 3 + 7 - 9 ÷ 3 = 20

After interchanging the number we get the;

⇒ 7 × 3 + 4 - 9 ÷ 3 = 20

⇒ 7 × 3 + 4 - 3 = 20

⇒ 21 + 4 - 3 = 20

⇒ 25 - 3 = 20

⇒ 22 ≠ 20

⇒ LHS ≠ RHS

Option 3) 7 + 4 × 2 - 6 ÷ 2 = 17

After interchanging the number we get the;

⇒ 4 + 7 × 2 - 6 ÷ 2 = 17

⇒ 4 + 7 × 2 - 3 = 17

⇒ 4 + 14 - 3 = 17

⇒ 18 - 3 = 17

⇒ 15 ≠ 17

⇒ LHS ≠ RHS

Option 4) 7 + 5 × 2 - 4 ÷ 1 = 9

After interchanging the number we get the;

⇒ 4 + 5 × 2 - 7 ÷ 1 = 9

⇒ 4 + 5 × 2 - 7 = 9

⇒ 4 + 10 - 7 = 9

⇒ 14 - 7 = 9

⇒ 7 ≠ 9

⇒ LHS ≠ RHS

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".

questions.question: By Interchanging the given two numbers which of the following equation will be correct? 5 and 9

5 and 9
questions.solution:
1) 9 – 5 × 4 + 6 ÷ 3 = 30

After interchanging the numbers 5 and 9, we get

5 – 9 × 4 + 6 ÷ 3 = 30

Applying the BODMAS Rule, we get

5 – 9 × 4 + 2 = 30

⇒ 5 – 36 + 2 = 30

⇒ 7 - 36 = 30

⇒ - 29 ≠ 30

The given equation is incorrect.

2) 9 × 3 + 5 ÷ 1 – 6 = 20

After interchanging the numbers 5 and 9, we get

5 × 3 + 9 ÷ 1 – 6 = 20

Applying the BODMAS Rule, we get

5 × 3 + 9 – 6 = 20

⇒ 15 + 9 - 6 = 20

⇒ 24 - 6 = 20

⇒ 18 ≠ 20

The given equation is incorrect.

3) 7 × 9 + 5 – 8 ÷ 4 = 40

After interchanging the numbers 5 and 9, we get

7 × 5 + 9 – 8 ÷ 4 = 40

Applying the BODMAS Rule, we get

7 × 5 + 9 – 2= 40

⇒ 35 + 9 - 2 = 40

⇒ 44 - 2 = 40

⇒ 42 ≠ 40

The given equation is incorrect.

4) 9 × 4 + 5 – 8 ÷ 2 = 25

After interchanging the numbers 5 and 9, we get

5 × 4 + 9 – 8 ÷ 2 = 25

Applying the BODMAS Rule, we get

5 × 4 + 9 – 4 = 25

⇒ 20 + 9 – 4 = 25

⇒ 29 - 4 = 25

⇒ 25 = 25

The given equation is correct.

Hence, the correct answer is '9 × 4 + 5 – 8 ÷ 2 = 25'.
